channel.title: Cobble Updates
channel.description: Signed Full releases of Cobble for macOS.

item.description:
# Cobble 0.1.0 beta
First Full build for **Apple silicon Macs running macOS 26 or later**.
- Native macOS browser with WebKit and Chromium engines. - Spaces, favorites, pins, folders and independent window tabs. - Signed in-app update checks, with installation and restart under your control.
Download the ZIP, extract Cobble, and drag it into Applications.
This is an early beta. Apple Passwords/passkeys, experimental extensions, login sharing and sync have limitations documented in the repository. Keep backups of important data. Report reproducible issues without including cookies or passwords.
